scope_note: This prototype covers Semester 1 for first-year students only. Years 2–4, other branches in detail, and historical question-paper archives are explicitly out of scope for v1.0.

conflicts.summary: Reported MAKAUT 2026 first-year syllabus structure differs from CEMK's published timetable in subject contact hours.
conflicts.resolution: Obtain the college's official Semester-1 registration / subject list before treating the structure as final.

conflicts.summary: Assessment weightage (internal vs ESE) rules for the applicable regulation are not yet confirmed by an official circular.
conflicts.resolution: SGPA engine uses a clearly labelled provisional rule table; do not hard-code uncertain university rules as official.

conflicts.summary: Group structure (Group A/B/...) for first-year elective/subject split is reported differently across secondary sources.
conflicts.resolution: Group data marked provisional; student can switch groups when the official registration list is published.
